title: How Long Can Cooked Rice Sit Out?

seo.title: How Long Can Cooked Rice Sit Out?
seo.meta_description: Cooked rice should be refrigerated promptly: as a practical rule, no more than about 2 hours at room temperature, or 1 hour above 90°F (32°C).
seo.search_intent: Make a safe decision about “how long can cooked rice sit out,” separating manageable conditions from signs that require stopping, discarding, or getting help.

excerpt: Cooked rice should be refrigerated promptly: as a practical rule, no more than about 2 hours at room temperature, or 1 hour above 90°F (32°C). Bacillus cereus spores can survive cooking and grow when rice is held warm.
content_html:
Cooked rice should be refrigerated promptly: as a practical rule, no more than about 2 hours at room temperature, or 1 hour above 90°F (32°C). Bacillus cereus spores can survive cooking and grow when rice is held warm.

Cool rice in shallow containers

Divide large amounts so they cool quickly and refrigerate them without leaving them on the counter for hours.

Do not rely on smell

Rice can look normal despite bacterial growth. Time and temperature are better criteria than appearance.

Hold it truly hot if not refrigerating

For service, proper hot holding keeps rice out of the danger zone. A switched-off cooker that slowly cools is not safe hot holding.

Reheating does not compensate for hours of unsafe holding

If rice sat out too long, discard it. Some toxins associated with bacterial growth may not be eliminated simply by reheating. Large pots of rice cool slowly in the center. Divide leftovers into shallow containers rather than placing one deep, tightly packed mass in the refrigerator and assuming the outside temperature represents the whole batch.
